name: Personal Agent Club
description: Personal agents (paired accounts at Cue, Grok Bot, Groq and your own muse2api server) as a source on the Agents page: their sessions, messages, sending and search. Accounts are paired on the extension's Accounts page; the assistant can drive the accounts you hand it.

demo_echo.title: Demo echo provider
demo_echo.description: Adds the in-memory echo provider, which answers every message with its own text. For trying the source out; nothing leaves the program.

browser_providers.title: Browser-backed providers (ego lite / CDP)
browser_providers.description: Enables Muse, Claude Duet, Gemini Tasks and Dots via a paired computer's browser (Persona browser.run, no exported cookies).

muse2api_url.title: muse2api server address
muse2api_url.description: Your own muse2api server (github.com/czg86389-hub/muse2api), e.g. http://<host>:18610. Set, Muse is offered on the Accounts page, paired with the server's API key (MUSE2API_KEY). The extension reaches this address and nothing else for it; a server on the hub machine itself is http://host.persona.internal:<port>.

muse2api_model.title: muse2api model
muse2api_model.description: The model muse2api accounts ask (muse-spark, or one of the server's aliases). muse2api sends every chat to Muse's one assistant whatever the model.

assistant_runtime.title: Main assistant runtime bridge
assistant_runtime.description: Exposes accounts enabled as Main assistant on Persona's agent runtime socket so they can run main-assistant and supervisor chats.
